instances.query:
I am playing with a set of tackyas where I need to arrange the tackyas into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a tackya
Unstack a tackya from on top of another tackya
Put down a tackya
Stack a tackya on top of another tackya

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one tackya at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a tackya if my hand is empty.
I can only pick up a tackya if the tackya is on the table and the tackya is clear. A tackya is clear if the tackya has no other tackyas on top of it and if the tackya is not picked up.
I can only unstack a tackya from on top of another tackya if the tackya I am unstacking was really on top of the other tackya.
I can only unstack a tackya from on top of another tackya if the tackya I am unstacking is clear.
Once I pick up or unstack a tackya, I am holding the tackya.
I can only put down a tackya that I am holding.
I can only stack a tackya on top of another tackya if I am holding the tackya being stacked.
I can only stack a tackya on top of another tackya if the tackya onto which I am stacking the tackya is clear.
Once I put down or stack a tackya, my hand becomes empty.
Once you stack a tackya on top of a second tackya, the second tackya is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the bagge tackya is clear, the hand is empty, the bagge tackya is on top of the dingert tackya, the dingert tackya is on top of the weavener tackya, the weavener tackya is on top of the amheight tackya and the amheight tackya is on the table.
My goal is to have that the bagge tackya is on top of the amheight tackya.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:
(unstack b2 b3)
(put-down b2)
(unstack b3 b4)
(put-down b3)
(unstack b4 b1)
(put-down b4)
(pick-up b2)
(stack b2 b1)
